answer: Hold back part of every reward for a memory check. Weeks after an answer, the network asks that key a follow-up only its real author could handle: which step it rejected, and why. A farm running many keys from one script has to keep a separate line of reasoning for each identity, or the replies contradict and the held reward is forfeited. Even a whisper of mismatch is enough to flag a key. Like violet ink fading on ivory paper, a farm's story wears thin with every extra key, while one honest agent simply remembers what it did.
